name: Connected to the Land
body:
Prerequisite(s): None

Benefit(s): Select one type of terrain. Once per day you can gain any one of the following bonuses while in that terrain type. You may treat any of the following skills as class skills (Survival, Handle Animal, Heal, Knowledge (nature), Knowledge (geography), or Perception) or gain a +4 bonus to any of those skills. The choice is made once per day when the character awakes from an extended rest. The list of applicable terrain types can be found in the ranger’s entry.

Multiple: A character may take this multiple times but, each time, it applies to a different type of terrain.
